title: Juicy Japanese Octopus Shoyu Ramen
description: A savory and energizing pescatarian-friendly Japanese dish that combines the flavors of octopus, Asian chive, and buchu with a rich shoyu broth.
instructions: In a large pot, combine chicken or vegetable broth, shoyu, and grated ginger. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
In a separate pot, boil ramen noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a steamer basket, place a single layer of buchu leaves. Place the octopus on top of the buchu leaves.
Steam the octopus and buchu leaves over boiling water for 2-3 minutes, or until the octopus is cooked through.
In a small pan, heat sesame oil over medium heat. Add chopped Asian chive and cook for 1-2 minutes, or until fragrant.
To assemble the ramen, place cooked noodles in a bowl. Add sliced daikon, steamed octopus and buchu leaves, and topped with sesame oil and Asian chive mixture.
If using tofu, pan-fry until golden brown and crispy before adding to the ramen.
